meta.name: TeleSweep
meta.tagline: Sweep worthless Telegram chats away — automatically

app.title: TeleSweep
app.subtitle: A local tool that scans your Telegram account, finds truly worthless chats, and removes them with your confirmation.
app.local_only: Everything runs on this machine — nothing ever leaves it.

auth.heading: Sign in
auth.hint: Paste the token shown in your terminal:
auth.token_hint: The token was printed in the terminal after running: telesweep web

scan.hint: Scanning is read-only. Nothing is deleted until you confirm.

cli.description: TeleSweep — automatically clean worthless Telegram chats
cli.epilog: Security note: the default mode is always dry-run. Real deletion requires explicit confirmation.

cli.i_know: Explicitly confirm you know this is destructive
cli.logout: Log out and delete the session
